posts.title: How To Record Cassette Tapes
posts.description: There are a lot of guides online for recording cassettes This is another one, because why not. This isn’t a guide for how to get the ~best~ sound, it’s just how I figured out to do it using stuff that was already around or easily accessible to me. posts.title: We Are All Cassettes - Part 2
posts.description: This is just like Fleet Reesy It surprised me (and a lot of people I tell) that the cassette tape economy is still very much alive. Mainstream contemporary artists still release tape editions of their albums (apparently Olivia Rodrigo gave tapes a Tiktok moment a while back, but I only know about that through others’ chatter).
